items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution and has been actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: SessionReaper: Improper Authentication leading to Session Hijacking/RCE
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing an attacker to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API, potentially leading to remote code execution. Adobe released a hotfix (VULN-32437) to address this issue.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any active exploits.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves important and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.
